notes: Monthly article sitemaps from /sitemap_index.xml (linked by robots.txt Sitemap: line); every entry is an absolute <loc> with <lastmod>, filter to the target date (lastmod = last update, revised older articles can appear on a later date). 2026-09 covers the full month (2352 URLs, 37-111/day); 2026-10 covers 01-24 (45-103/day). No daily archive page: /archives/2026-09-30 is 404 and robots only disallows /archives/ for Googlebot-News. Article URLs always end _<numeric id>.html on www.franceinfo.fr (the outlet's francetvinfo.fr brand redirects to franceinfo.fr). robots.txt allows the sitemap and articles to our UA.
